reviews.title: The best platform to generate free organic traffic to your website.
reviews.pros: i like how easy it is to find customers to sell your products to and simple it is to publish and get organic views.
reviews.cons: Pinterest is one of my favorite platforms so there isn't any bad aspect of it for me, except i wish they return the multiple pics per post feature.
reviews.overall: it was really wonderful i was able to generate more leads and sales very easily through it and for free.

reviews.title: HD pictures and great user experience.
reviews.pros:
1. The user interface of the application is intuitive and clean looking.

2. The search features works accurate all the time in displaying most relevant search results.

3. It helps a lot in transforming an idea into a picture by taking inspiration from the already created pictures and art.

4. Pictures and GIFs can be saved or pin for future use.

5. Images can be downloaded in high quality.
reviews.cons: 1. There hasn't been any solid con in my usage, everything works perfectly.
reviews.overall: Overall, Pinterest is a great application for taking inspiration and ideas from the pictures and designs available on the platforms.

reviews.title: Your Idea Comes Alive
reviews.pros: Pinterest helps give you ideas of how to design, travel, cook etc. I also like you how can then add your ideas on there too.
reviews.cons: I don't like how most recipes on Pinterest send you to a blog. Then these blogs usually have so much unnecessary information that you have to scroll through.
reviews.overall: Overall, I love how you can have an idea in your mind and then most likely find it on Pinterest. It is so much easier to show people a picture of what you are thinking instead of trying to explain it.

reviews.title: Best platform to search for images and ideas.
reviews.pros:
- Pinterest is the best platform to search and explore for images of the latest trends.

- The images are of high quality and can be downloaded easily with single click.

- The recommendation algorithm works great in suggesting the relevant images according to the previous searches.

- It is available on all the platforms.
reviews.cons:
- There isn't any feature to download the videos directly from the application.

- The recommendation feed changes drastically after every search and does not show the feed according to the aggregate of all searches.
reviews.overall: Overall, Pinterest can be used multi-purposely for exploring new trends or to search for new designs. It is also a great platform which helps brainstorming and finding new ideas.

reviews.title: Love this platform
reviews.pros: It's so nice to be able to get ideas of what other people do. I am not a very creative person, but the amount of ideas I get form Pinterest is amazing!
reviews.cons: I dislike that I have to be signed in to effectively use Pinterest. I just want to look at things sometimes and I have to go through the whole log in just to see things.
reviews.overall: Love Pinterest. I get so many ideas and have made my house look nicer and have so many little projects goin on right now.

reviews.title: A place to get inspiration.
reviews.pros: Pinterest helps in discovering high definition images of designs and art to get inspiration from. The images can also be downloaded easily. The follow features helps tremendously in following creators with similar interest. The suggestion features works accurately every time in suggesting new posts and creators with similar creations. The feed of the application is also designed well and scrolling is seamless.
reviews.cons: There is no dislike button on Pinterest, so there is no way to let the Pinterest algorithm know that you dislike something.
reviews.overall: Pinterest is overall a great application to find designs, to get inspiration and ideas. The images available on platform in high definition quality.

reviews.title: All-in-one tool for image searching.
reviews.pros:
1. The user interface of the application is intuitive and attractive.

2. It helps in finding high quality images of almost anything.

3. The search works amazingly in finding the exact results searched by the user.

4. Posts can be pinned for future reference.

5. It helps tremendously in finding designs and getting inspiration for application user interface.
reviews.cons: 1. There isn't anything to dislike about this application.
reviews.overall: Overall, Pinterest is an all-in-one image searching application that can be used by anyone from UI designers to graphics designers or students to finds designs and ideas for their projects.

reviews.title: Helps with creativity.
reviews.pros:
- The layout of the application is beautiful and simple to use.

- It helps in taking inspiration and generating creative visual ideas.

- The suggestion algorithm of Pinterest works great.
reviews.cons: - Finding the source of an image can be a difficult task sometimes.
reviews.overall: Overall, Pinterest is a great application to find and gather creative visual ideas. The application works great in suggesting post according to the user preferences.

reviews.title: Best for Creative Inspiration
reviews.pros:
Fantastic application to grasp creative inspiration.

Massive categories to choose from and pin.

Recommended.
reviews.cons: Irrelevant images that are posted and long pins are only cons.
reviews.overall:
Great place for both sharing images and getting ideas from images. 

User can pin images for references later on.

reviews.title: To get or Share Ideas
reviews.pros: Pinterest is an amazing platform to share images, DIYs, ideas, home remedies and many more things. Things are divided into categories like styling, studying, decoration etc. It's effortless to use and kind of search engine app. There are no such boundaries as you do not need to follow to see the content. You can easily pin and save the boards with different named folders.
reviews.cons: Pinterest is a heavy app and takes a good amount of space on your phone. You can not limit the audience for your pinned boards. Thus, it will be available to everyone. Creating an account is mandatory on Pinterest. It shows many ads, even in a short video.
reviews.overall: It's a good app to search for any ideas, and you can easily save a lot of time. The only limit is that there's very less privacy and it shows a lot of advertisements.

reviews.title: Personally or Professionally best software
reviews.pros: Pinterest is an awesome software. Thousands of images with thousands of ideas we can get within a minute. Allows to pin images on board. Easy to use. Highly customisable features. Personally or professionally  it's very useful software.  It can be used on both mobile and desktop.
reviews.cons: Personally very good software. Easy to use. Highly recommended. No cons.
reviews.overall: User friendly software. Easy-to-understand, use and navigate. Once we start searching on any topic it goes scrolling and scrolling, full of information. Tons of ideas with quality. Very helpful in sharing information. new training is required to using it beginners or students can also start using it instantly.

reviews.title: A Massive Image Sharing Platform
reviews.pros:
Easy to navigate with proper categorization.

Vast catalog of pictures of all topics.

Great mobile app.

Create your own boards with handpicked images.

Privacy options.
reviews.cons:
Doesn't allow  to view photos using a link if not signed in.

Following a topic automatically adds you to email subscription.
reviews.overall: Pinterest is the Internet's image repository with thematic ordering of images. One can find images of any or all topics here, making it great for any research purpose or even just for casual browsing.

reviews.title: Love to Scroll
reviews.pros: I like that I can spend longer than I should scrolling through and still find new ideas that are marketed towards my interests.
reviews.cons: Sometimes it is too specifically marketed and too similar of posts continue to show up.
reviews.overall: I enjoy zoning out on my phone and scrolling through Pinterest to get new ideas and almost anything.

reviews.title: Fun and helpful
reviews.pros: Great way to find new idea and ways to create or make things. Lots of do it yourself ideas and tips.
reviews.cons: I don't like the iOS mobile interface as it's hard to use.
reviews.overall: Overall it's great because you can save and organize ideas together to help and reference later on.
